power: Fixed mean-Es2 constellation, no per-frame normalization; record all frame energies, mean/SD/quantiles/extrema

raw64.enumeration: Every nonempty canonical (m,K) with 12*(sum(s_i**2 for i<m)+K)<=k-29, for each admitted actual backend bucket
raw64.K: Every integer, including K=0; full next scale canonicalizes to m+1,K0. No artificial m8 boundary.
raw64.empty: No-payload/gray is a failure reference, not an uncharged competing action
raw64.search_claim: Complete legal action enumeration within these four rates; bounded expected-quality prescreen plus real shortlisted calibration, not globally proven optimal PHY
raw64.clean_quality: All distinct legal raw64 states on the fixed hash200, mean per-source PSNR/MSE; same reconstruction reused across physical rates
raw64.shortlist: After registered physical table/refinement, retain top3 distinct candidate profiles per main SNR by expected PSNR; all integer K participate
raw64.real_calibration: Each retained profile on original1000 with3 fresh calibration noises; select mean per-image PSNR, all frames retained

wire.header: 12-bit public profile ID, CRC16, tail6 convolutional protected/rate-matched to136 bits =68 QPSK symbols
wire.body: 13-bit L | exactly L source bits | zeros to k-16 | CRC16
wire.L: Includes canonical arithmetic termination; excludes storage-only byte padding
wire.CRC: Covers length, source payload and all actual zero padding; receive CRC before parse
wire.layout: Public profile gives k,n,q,m,K,mode before body decode. Unknown ID rejected; wrong accepted known ID follows actual selected layout.
wire.arithmetic: One continuous stream for a whole prefix; 32-bit integer state, TOTAL2**24, minfrequency1, floor(prob*(TOTAL-4096))+1, remainder to first maximum

finite_zero_extension.rule: Allow only30 zero reads beyond declared payload; independently re-encode decoded tokens under receiver-generated CDF and require exact canonical bit equality
finite_zero_extension.reason: Current finish emits renormalization_count+2 bits; this decoder consumes renormalization_count+32. Never read k-padding as source stream.

wire.invalid: CRC-accepted illegal L/padding/noncanonical/truncated stream produces registered gray; record decode_invalid
wire.accepted_wrong: If parser accepts wrong actual bits, render actual recovered tokens. Ground truth comparison is evaluation only.

scrambling.rule: One public PCG64 mask from SHA256(protocol,session,public_frame_counter,group) after rate matching

fallback.order: Target whole m then m-1 down to m6; final paid profile carries actual m and mode
fallback.arithmetic_choice: For each attempted m use arithmetic only if strictly shorter than raw; raw wins equal length; retain attempted lengths
fallback.if_no_m6_fits: Transmit registered m6 raw (fits all planned buckets); if actual backend rejects that bucket, bucket is unavailable
fallback.after_transmission: No retransmission or free m8 rescue. All four H arms use whole-body DROP gray on rejection.

population.initial: Reuse exact S1 source200 list, originally source-ID hash200 from construction800; no reselection
population.full_calibration: Original registered1000 only; full1000 is calibration, not independent holdout
population.development: Original100 sources; fixed3 new channel noise draws
population.seed_rule: PCG64 from first16 SHA256 bytes of canonical [H protocol,stage,source_id,snr,seed]; same underlying1024x2 standard Gaussian for matched methods; different waveform is not same observation
population.expected_prescreen: Clean-state PSNR and measured header/body C/R/U frequencies; unknown accepted image state uses gray PSNR ONLY as explicit screening surrogate; actual shortlisted U must be decoded/rendered. No real U image may be scored by the surrogate.

calibration.coarse: 8 unique admitted q/r body layouts x3 SNR x2048 independent random messages; each body call charged; header separately qualified
calibration.refine: At most2 body layout/SNR cells receive6144 additional calls to total8192; no automatic transfer from later phase quotas
calibration.refine_eligible: Main SNR13/19 only, 0.01<=observed BLER<=0.99, and that cell is used by a top2 expected-PSNR candidate whose Wilson95 PSNR interval overlaps the current best candidate interval
calibration.refine_order: Descending induced PSNR interval width among qualifying top2 candidates; tie SNR ascending, q ascending, exact rational rate ascending; freeze list before any added calls
calibration.four_arm_initial: For each4 arms x2 main SNR choose at most2 target-m/r policies by expected PSNR over all whole targets/rates/fallback outcomes; actual200x3 per candidate; at most19200 header/body calls
calibration.four_arm_full: Per arm/SNR retain1 by actual200 mean PSNR, then full1000x3 real payload validation;48000 calls maximum. Full1000 not an excuse to add an unregistered alternative.
calibration.partial_full: At most3 candidates per SNR,1000x3,36000 calls maximum; select after complete population
calibration.ties: Mean per-image PSNR within1e-12: fewer average attempted TX probability scales, then lower q, lower rational rate, lower target m/K, lexical profile key

matched_attribution.source: Same155 raw tokens at all arms; arithmetic may choose raw if not shorter, paid mode; no source truncation differences
matched_attribution.status_rule: Must be actual-admitted existing whole-grid point; otherwise NOT_FEASIBLE, never replace from development
matched_attribution.purpose: Auxiliary fixed-source contrast; optimized per-arm system results reported separately

development.P: P1024 same100 sources13/19dB; reuse compatible checkpoints, otherwise inference only; exact seed compatibility explicit

qualification.uncoded_check: Exact coherent uniform square-QAM SER at Es/N0, and independent actual decision-region integration; empirical discrepancy <=5 standard errors+0.001
qualification.coded_check: No invented closed-form LDPC BLER; report measured curve and Wilson intervals. Adjacent-SNR nonoverlap of99.9% Wilson success intervals in reversed direction flags implementation for diagnosis; weak but valid performance is scientific evidence.
qualification.bits_interleaver: Exact no-noise decoded bits, LLR sign for every constellation label, permutation/inverse, k/n/filler/puncturing all verified
qualification.sampling_power: Constellation exact Es2; actual scrambled frame energy distribution recorded, not normalized

success.statistics: Per-source mean3 noises, then paired percentile95 bootstrap10000 repetitions seed2026100605 per SNR; original100 development, not new holdout
success.main_reference: Both full1000-calibrated raster+KEEP LDPC QPSK and16QAM, with registered within-family objective unchanged; S1 bridge is not full calibration
success.positive: For each13/19dB H-versus-main PSNR CI lower>0; LPIPS difference CI upper<=0; CLIP and ConvNeXt source-prediction-agreement difference CI lower>=0
success.primary_independent_classifier: ConvNeXt (existing metric identity), never used in selection; ResNet50 supplementary
success.uncertainty: CI crossing0 is UNRESOLVED, never evidence of no deterioration
success.coverage: Report each SNR/reference separately; full two-SNR superiority claim needs both SNRs. All matched P gaps still reported.
success.P_gap: Narrowing of (P-main)-(P-H) equals H-main; do not double-count it as independent evidence
success.only_DINO: representation-target-only, no claim of content correctness

timing.online: Fixed16 development sources, isolated GPU, no per-image probability/final-output cache; all failed/fallback attempts counted

order: full main calibration needed for comparisons
schedule.on_unqualified_deadline: Pause H; prioritize original main-system calibration and paper evidence; do not substitute C or extend deadline
schedule.failure: Preserve evidence; stop dependent stages and diagnose; no blind automatic retries
schedule.execution: Immutable stage-batch revisions bind implemented entrypoints. Pending stages are explicitly not launched until their executable revision is sealed; scientific selection rules stay unchanged.
